title: Workflow operations
description: The events that start each workflow, and the scripts the workflows call, which can also be run by hand from the repository root.

entities.name: Check a pull request
entities.description: Validates the .dev files and tests and builds each game the pull request changes.
entities.authorization: None checked by the workflow: GitHub runs it for every pull request.
entities.result: Check results on the pull request: the diagrams job, and one game job per changed game; nothing is deployed.
failures: A .dev file fails a validator: the diagrams job fails.
A changed game's install, tests or build fail, or its build holds a .dev folder: that game's job fails, and the others still run (fail-fast false).

entities.name: Check a pull request's database changes
entities.description: The required Database migration check, run again whenever the description is edited.
entities.transport: GitHub pull_request event: opened, edited, synchronize, reopened
entities.authorization: None checked by the workflow; it reads the pull request with the run's own token.
entities.result: Passes when no worker/schema.sql or worker/migrations/ file changed, or when the description acknowledges the migration; prints the command for each changed file.
failures: A database file changed and the description has no acknowledgement line: the check fails, and main refuses the merge.

entities.name: Deploy the changed games
entities.description: Deploys each game a push to main changed, once the migration gate passes.
entities.authorization: Only pull requests reach main (AGENTS.md); deploy jobs run in the production environment, with its reviewer if one is set, and need CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN.
entities.result: Each changed game tested, built and deployed with wrangler deploy; a change to .dev files alone deploys nothing.
failures: A database change since the last deploy is not acknowledged: the migrations job fails and nothing is deployed.
A game's tests, build or deploy fail: that game is not deployed, and the others still are.

entities.name: Deploy by hand
entities.description: Run workflow on deploy.yml deploys one game, or all, from main.
entities.transport: GitHub workflow_dispatch, with the inputs game and migration_applied
entities.authorization: Whoever GitHub lets run workflows in the repository; the same production environment and secret as a push.
entities.result: The chosen game, or every game, deployed; migration_applied acknowledges any database change since the last deploy.
failures: A database change is not acknowledged and migration_applied is not ticked: nothing is deployed.

entities.name: List the changed games
entities.description: Which games have a package.json and changed between a commit and HEAD.
entities.result: A JSON array of game folders. Files in .dev folders are left out; a change under .github/ means every game; with no base, or one Git cannot diff against, every game.

entities.name: Find the last deployed commit
entities.description: The commit the last successful Deploy run deployed, where the migration gate starts.
entities.authorization: gh signed in with read access to the repository's Actions runs.
entities.result: That commit; else the push's before commit; else nothing, when Git has neither.

entities.name: Run the migration gate
entities.description: Lists the database files changed since a commit and fails unless their migration is acknowledged.
entities.transport: .github/scripts/migration-gate.sh pr <base sha> <pull request number> | deploy [<base sha>]
entities.authorization: gh signed in with read access to pull requests.
entities.result: Exits 0 when there is no database change or every change is acknowledged (in the pull request, by the pull request that brought each commit, or by migration_applied); prints how to apply each changed file.
failures: A change is not acknowledged: exit 1, with an error annotation.
No mode, or an unknown one: the usage line, exit 2.

relatedViews.relationship: Shipping a change goes through them.
Migrating a database is checked by the gate.
